Can you find 5 delivery drivers with the highest average number of daily deliveries?

WITH daily_deliveries AS (
    SELECT 
        d.driver_id,
        o.order_created_year,
        o.order_created_month,
        o.order_created_day,
        1 as delivery_count
    FROM deliveries d
    JOIN orders o ON d.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
    WHERE d.driver_id IS NOT NULL
        AND o.order_created_year IS NOT NULL
        AND o.order_created_month IS NOT NULL
        AND o.order_created_day IS NOT NULL
),
driver_daily_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_id,
        order_created_year,
        order_created_month,
        order_created_day,
        COUNT(*) as daily_delivery_count
    FROM daily_deliveries
    GROUP BY driver_id, order_created_year, order_created_month, order_created_day
)
SELECT 
    driver_id,
    AVG(daily_delivery_count) as avg_daily_deliveries
FROM driver_daily_counts
GROUP BY driver_id
ORDER BY avg_daily_deliveries DESC
